image_description: A close-up, ground-level shot of a yellow-orange coral fungus (Ramaria or similar genus) growing on a forest floor covered in pine needles, twigs, and small rocks. The fungus exhibits a complex, multi-branched structure rising from a central base, with numerous upright, cylindrical branches that taper towards the tips. The background includes dark soil, decaying organic matter, and a blurred tree trunk or root system.
